Using the property $|z_1 z_2| = |z_1| |z_2|$:

We know that $|i|=1$ and $|e^{i\theta}| = |\cos\theta + i\sin\theta| = \sqrt{\cos^2\theta + \sin^2\theta} = 1$.

Alternatively, using the half-angle identity $1+\cos\theta = 2\cos^2(\theta/2)$:

\[
\lim_{n\to\infty}\min_{H\text{ triangle‑free on }n\text{ vertices}} \frac{i_8(H)}{\binom{n}{8}}.
\]
